Text A. On Saturday, I woke up early and had breakfast with Dad. We went to the library. I found a book about space and read it in a quiet corner. We came home before lunchtime. It was a calm start to the weekend.

Text B. Yesterday afternoon, I went to my aunt’s house. I thought we were visiting for tea, but my friends were waiting there. They gave me a birthday cake and sang to me. I was so excited that I could not speak for a moment.

Text C. On Sunday, I got up late and had a quick breakfast. I took my little brother to football practice with Mum. After lunch, we went shopping. I wrote in my diary at night, but I could not finish my book because I was tired.
